centre.title: Verification
centre.intro: Verified profiles get more replies and can send more interests each day. It is free.
centre.footer: Your documents are seen only by our review team and are deleted 30 days after the decision.
centre.closed: The profile is closed. Reopen it to send a verification request.

identity.title: Identity document
identity.not_started: Add your CNIC number, then upload the card.
identity.number_added: Upload the card to get the badge.
identity.pending: Under review. We usually finish within 24 hours.
identity.rejected: Not approved: {{reason}}. You can try again.

photo.title: Photo check
photo.not_started: Take a quick selfie so members know your photos are really you.
photo.rejected: Not approved: {{reason}}. You can try again.

cancel.title: Cancel this verification request?
cancel.description: The documents you sent are deleted. You can send a new request at any time.

reason.unreadable: We could not read the image clearly. Please take a sharper photo in good light, with the whole card visible.
reason.document_mismatch: The details on the document do not match the profile (name, date of birth, gender or number). If the profile has a mistake you cannot edit, email {{support_email}} and we will help.
reason.face_mismatch: The selfie does not match the document or the profile photos. Please make sure the selfie shows {{name}}, and that every profile photo is of {{name}}.
reason.face_mismatch_self: The selfie does not match the document or the profile photos. Please make sure the selfie shows you, and that every profile photo is of you.
reason.gesture_missing: The selfie did not show the requested gesture. Please take a new selfie and follow the instruction on the screen.
reason.expired_document: The document has expired. Please upload a valid one.
reason.underage: The candidate must be at least 18 years old to use Khandani Rishta.
reason.suspected_fraud: We could not accept this document. If you believe this is a mistake, email {{support_email}}.
reason.other: We could not approve the request. Please try again or email {{support_email}}.

gesture.peace_sign: Hold up two fingers next to your face
gesture.thumbs_up: Give a thumbs up next to your face
gesture.open_palm: Show your open palm next to your face
gesture.hand_on_head: Place one hand flat on top of your head
gesture.changed: The requested gesture has changed. Please take a new selfie.

camera.denied: We need the camera for this check. Allow camera access in your settings and try again.
camera.denied_help: In your browser, select the camera icon or the lock icon next to the address, allow the camera for this site, then select Try again.
camera.unavailable: Open Khandani Rishta on your phone to take the selfie
camera.unavailable_help: This browser cannot use a camera. A phone browser or the Android app can take the selfie.

selfie.title: Photo check
selfie.body: Take one selfie of {{name}} doing the gesture below. We compare it with the profile photos. The selfie is never shown on the profile and is deleted 30 days after our decision.
selfie.body_self: Take one selfie of yourself doing the gesture below. We compare it with the profile photos. The selfie is never shown on the profile and is deleted 30 days after our decision.
selfie.managed: This selfie must be of {{name}}, the person this profile is for.
selfie.success: Thank you. We usually review within 24 hours.
selfie.already_exists: A selfie is already being reviewed.

identity.title: Verify identity
identity.tips: Place the card on a dark, flat surface. Make sure all four corners are visible. Avoid glare. Do not cover any part of the card.
identity.choose_front: Take or choose a photo of the front
identity.choose_back: Take or choose a photo of the back
identity.choose_passport: Take or choose a photo of the photo page
identity.selfie_body: Now a quick selfie of {{name}} so we can match the card. {{gesture}}
identity.selfie_body_self: Now a quick selfie of yourself so we can match the card. {{gesture}}
identity.success: Thank you. We will review your documents, usually within 24 hours. You can keep using the app meanwhile.
identity.already_exists: A request is already being reviewed.
identity.pending: Under review. We usually finish within 24 hours.

errors.too_large: This photo is too large. Please retake it.
errors.upload_failed: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unsupported_type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.unreadable: This photo could not be read. Please take it again.
